places.name: Castle Rock (Jasper)
places.access: Lot on private land the SCC leases: text your car's make to the owner (number at the kiosk); don't park if full; no camping.

places.name: Denny Cove
places.access: South Cumberland State Park: free online climbing registration; no overnight parking; rough gravel road of about a mile off US-41.

places.name: Foster Falls
places.access: South Cumberland State Park: free online climbing registration each visit; no rappelling in the climbing areas; off the trail by dark.

places.name: Leda
places.access: Private (Montlake Golf Course): check in, sign the waiver and pay at the golf course first; small lot; roadside pull-offs are tow zones.

places.name: Stone Fort (Little Rock City)
places.access: Private golf course: sign the waiver and buy a day pass at the clubhouse; no dogs, night bouldering or camping.

places.name: Sunset Rock
places.access: NPS military park: tiny West Brow lot, no street or yard parking; groups of 10 or more need a permit; no fixed protection.

places.name: Tennessee Wall
places.access: Prentice Cooper State Forest: no climbing during scheduled spring and fall hunts (check the dates each season); car break-ins at the lot are common.
